scoring_justification: Thermal conductivity compared to paper-reported values; phonon dispersion and accumulated kappa audited structurally; full recompute of Green-Kubo integrals from raw trajectory data is infeasible without re-running heavy EMD.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported anisotropic lattice thermal conductivity at 300 K (gold for reference_match and accumulated-kappa consistency)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'A deep neural network interatomic potential for studying thermal conductivity of β-Ga2O3' (Appl. Phys. Lett. 117, 152102 (2020)), Figure 3(a) caption and main text
hidden_assets.generation_method: hardcoded values: κ[100]=10.68 W/mK, κ[010]=20.78 W/mK, κ[001]=12.61 W/mK
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: directly extracted from the paper's reported results; the reference solver writes exactly these numbers

outputs.description: Phonon dispersion curves along three high‑symmetry directions; the checker computes RMSE against a hidden DFT reference and scores full credit if RMSE ≤ 0.5 THz.

Anisotropic lattice thermal conductivity at 300 K; the checker compares the reported values to the paper’s reported values with a relative tolerance of ±20% for each direction and verifies the ordering κ[010] > κ[001] > κ[100].

Accumulated thermal conductivity versus mode frequency; the checker verifies monotonic increase and that the final saturated values are consistent with the total κ from thermal_conductivity.json within ±20%.

output_contract.notes: The agent must train the NNP from scratch; using a pre‑trained potential is not allowed. The EMD simulations are computationally heavy and may benefit from remote GPU clusters; the scoring relies on re‑computation of the reported thermal conductivity values and structural checks on the modal analysis output.

steps.description: Validate keys, non-empty arrays, non-negativity, plausible maximum frequency, acoustic branches near zero, and minimal number of modes.
Compare reported κ to paper gold with ±20% per direction and verify directional ordering.
Check monotonic increase of accumulated columns, required columns, and final accumulated values within ±20% of gold κ.
